rows.text: Revenue increased 14% to $176.9K, driven by Email channel growth, but Paid Social faces a critical risk with declining efficiency.
Email revenue surged 68% to $54.3K with no ad spend, making it a highly efficient growth source.
Organic Search revenue rose 5% to $37.5K, contributing positively without any ad spend.
Paid Social ROAS fell from 2.5× to 1.3× while ad spend rose 73% to $13.0K, indicating declining efficiency.
Marketplace return rate increased from 12.2% to 18.0%, impacting profitability.
Cut Paid Social ad spend back to last period's ~$7.5K this week and pause the weakest ad sets.
Audit Marketplace for the most-returned products to identify issues and reduce the return rate.
Investigate why Organic Search revenue increased and replicate successful strategies across other channels.
